title: Can Air Pressure Crush a Metal Can?
description:
Cool a little steam inside a can, and the atmosphere does the crushing.

When steam condenses, pressure inside drops; higher external atmospheric pressure collapses the can.

The can is not “sucked in.” Unbalanced outside pressure pushes it inward.

Sea-level atmosphere pushes with roughly 100,000 pascals over every exposed surface.
